desc:
## Accepted scope split - 2026-10-05

User approved closing GK-005 and BO-GK-005 as the completed business-input stage. Deferred legal review, actual provider/privacy inventory and final product-label verification moved to [GK-037](https://trello.com/c/Zarzv2Qo).

Revised acceptance: approved business/FSA/contact/VAT input; recipe/allergen/coating/substitution and money decisions; explicit privacy/retention/access/browser/analytics/email choices; versioned interview evidence and linked deferred checks. See closure decision comments and docs/creator/GK-005/interview-2026-10-05.md with its source/evidence manifest.

GK-005 input is accepted for GK-011/019/027/033; other prerequisites remain. GK-019 must reconcile canonical JSON/SQL/admin contracts from interview-r1 before affected implementation. Older JSON alone is incomplete.

GK-035 sandbox acceptance can finish before GK-037. Gate: GK-035 -> GK-037 -> GK-036. Closure does not claim deferred checks passed or authorise production release.

## Historical original scope (superseded where the split differs)

## Context

Priority: P0 — foundational or money/security/fulfillment correctness prerequisite.
Order: 40; Wave: 0; Parallel group: Creator decisions W00.
Requirements: C05, C06, C09, C14, C15, A05, A11, S01, S02; Design/contract revision: planning r5, K01 K03 K08.
Agent execution policy: not applicable (Creator-owned action).
Depends on: none; deliverable: completed approved policy, setup/contract or tested implementation evidence from each listed prerequisite. All GK-020 dependents require B2 unless explicitly named B1.
Unblocks: GK-011, GK-019, GK-027, GK-033, GK-036.
Safe in parallel with: GK-001, GK-003, GK-004, GK-006, GK-007, GK-002. Independent Creator evidence collection; master reconciles overlapping policies before GK-019.
Conflicts with: shared contracts/schema/ADRs and adjacent modules; implementation owner coordinates shared edits, no same-wave implied safety.
Readiness at publication: ready now for Creator action.

There is currently no application; this is an ordered planning packet. Verify existing food-business registration with relevant London local authority and current government/FSA/ICO guidance in provider-research.md. Supply legal/trading/contact details, VAT treatment, before-purchase and handover allergen information, customer promises/statutory-rights wording and retention/privacy/analytics classifications. This task does not authorize agent legal filing or guess exemptions.

Applicable common rules: server owns prices/availability/state; GBP integer pence, UTC instants plus Europe/London display and date semantics; role/ownership checked on every action; Idempotency-Key and expected_version protect repeated/stale mutations; pending external result is not success/failure. No network calls under database locks. Detailed requirements and tests below remain mandatory even if linked files change.

References: docs/design/contracts.md K01 K03 K08; docs/design/screens.md; docs/design/coverage.md; relevant docs/design/features/ packet; docs/planning/DELIVERY.md; SETUP.md. These are local unpushed planning artifacts; obtain this checkout's exact fingerprinted packet before execution.

## To dos

T1. Review current prerequisites and the concrete options/rules in Context; collect missing evidence (AC1).
T2. Perform only the Creator action described, recording settings/decision versions and safe nonsecret evidence (AC1–AC3).
T3. Check the acceptance examples, record remaining blockers and hand the approved output to dependent Agent tickets (AC3, AC4).

## Not to dos

Do not implement unrelated cleanup, register candidate alternatives, expose credentials, publish releases or deploy without the separate scoped authorization. Planning publication does not authorize application execution now. Do not mark Done without the board's acceptance.

## Acceptance Criteria

AC1. Chef/business owner records registration/status evidence and approved public contact/terms without exposing identity documents.
AC2. Tax calculation/rounding and refund allocation examples are signed off; product and fulfillment copy includes allergens before purchase and at handover.
AC3. Transactional versus marketing email, browser storage and analytics/retention decisions are explicit and versioned; unresolved legal points stay blocked.
AC4. Required acceptance evidence is tied to exact input/output revision, checked by the appropriate reviewer/Creator and recorded on Trello. For implementation include relevant tests, all related PRs, required review/checks, merge and main CI; authorized release/deployment/smoke only when separately in scope.

Verification: inspect the concrete decision/configuration and nonsecret evidence against AC1–AC3. No forced software red/green cycle for human work. Account creation follows accepted-provider gate; no secret values in Trello.
